content.short: Otim gives finance platforms APIs to hold funds, earn yield and move money globally on-chain.
content.description: Otim offers treasury and payment settlement infrastructure by API: platforms can hold user balances, earn programmable yield with control over attribution and liquidity, and move money between parties with predictable settlement. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Otim.
content.meta: Otim provides treasury, yield and settlement APIs for finance platforms, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
